concerns.text: FR-009 says noise is injected at 'σ=0.5°' but also 'sweeping the noise level' — the sweep range and step are unspecified, and it is unclear whether σ=0.5° is the sole level or one point in the sweep. State the concrete noise levels (or that σ=0.5° is the single level) so the reported 'variance in model accuracy' has a defined measurement procedure.

The ambiguous-signal edge case requires reporting accuracy on 'this ambiguous subset' and flagging if < 50%, but no procedure defines how the ambiguous subset is identified (identical trajectories with conflicting labels? nearest-neighbor collision in trajectory space?). Without a defined subset-construction rule, the < 50% check is not executable. Specify the identification procedure or reframe as a confusion-matrix report only.

SC-006's 'static analysis of the evaluation code for constant return statements' is a weak verification procedure — a hard-coded metric could be computed inline or read from a fabricated intermediate. Acceptable as-is, but consider anchoring to re-running the evaluation script and confirming metrics reproduce from the persisted artifacts, which is a deterministic check.
